name: Delaware Water Gap National Recreation Area
story: The Delaware Water Gap National Recreation Area is a 70,000-acre national recreation area administered by the National Park Service in northwest New Jersey and northeast Pennsylvania. It features the Delaware Water Gap, a mountain pass where the river cuts between Blue Mountain and Kittatinny Mountain, and includes numerous waterfalls.
matters: The park includes Worthington State Forest and a section of the long-distance Appalachian Trail, and preserves historical sites from early Dutch settlement and the Minisink region.
